summary: Wisconsin's Commissioner of Insurance gave written notice on July 21, 2017 of a new basic loss ratio of 42% for credit life and new prima facie credit life rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2018. Single life: $0.40 per annum per $100 (single premium decreasing), $0.74 (level) and $0.616 per month per $1,000 (outstanding balance). Joint rates are 167% of single.
